verses.1: And Balaam said to Balak, “Give me seven golden calves as offerings. And give me also seven sheep and seven bulls.”
verses.2: And Balak did as Balaam said. Balak built a platform, and Balaam brought grain and fruit from the field onto that platform.
verses.3: And Balaam said to Balak, “Stand on your feet! I will go ahead and do what Yahweh has commanded me to do. I will tell you everything that He has told me.” And Balak went away.
verses.4: And God came to Balaam. He said to him, “I have prepared the offerings for the sacrifice. I will offer sheep and cattle as sacrifices.”
verses.5: And Jehovah made it happen through Bilam’s mouth. He said, “Go back to Balak again, and say this.”
verses.6: And he sat down beside him. And behold, Moab and all his people stood on their feet.
verses.7: And he set his staff on the ground, and said, “Let me rest here, in the land of Moab, near the ruins of ancient times. Let me be with Jacob and Israel.”
verses.8: What can I do? I cannot obey him. What can I do to get rid of his anger? Jehovah’s anger is too great for me to bear.
verses.9: For from the beginning, we were seen by them as a people who are separate from others. They will dwell alone in their own land, and among other nations, they will not be recognized.
verses.10: Who can compare with Jacob’s strength? Who can count the number of Israel’s men who have died? Their souls are dead, and they are like those who have died. May I be like them.
verses.11: And Balak said to Bileam, “What have you done to me? You have caused my enemies to take you away from me. And now, you are blessed.”
verses.12: And he said, “For those whom Jehovah places in his mouth, He will surely keep them speaking.”
verses.13: And he said to him, “Please take me to another place where you can see it from there. Then you’ll be able to see it clearly, and everything will be visible to you.” And they gave him that place to go to.
verses.14: And the priest took him to the top of the mountain. There, he built seven altars. He also placed sheep and goats on those altars.
verses.15: And he said to Balak, “Stand on your feet, and I will stand also.”
verses.16: And Jehovah spoke to Balaam. He said, “Go back to Balak, and tell him this.”
verses.17: And he came to him. He was standing on his threshold, with the officers of Moab surrounding him. Balak said to him, “What does Jehovah want?”
verses.18: And he raised his hand and said, “Stand up! Listen to me carefully!”
verses.19: No one can be a thief or a deceiver. And no human being should be allowed to do such things. He said, “Do not do it.” And he also said, “Do not create such things.”
verses.20: Now, may it be blessed for me to take it; and may it also be blessed, but I will not return it.
verses.21: He did not look at Jacob, nor did he see Amalek in Israel. Jehovah, his God, was with him. And the king was defeated.
verses.22: Let them be brought out of Egypt, like birds flying away.
verses.23: For Yaakov and Israel have not been given any guidance at this time. It will be said to Yaakov and Israel, “What shall we do?”
verses.24: They will also rise up like dogs, and they will be thrown down. They will not be able to lie down until they eat their prey. And the blood of the slain will flow everywhere.
verses.25: And Balak said to Bileam, “Do not bless us either. Do not bless us at all.”
verses.26: And Balaam said to Balak, “I have already told you that whatever God says, I will do.”
verses.27: And Balak said to Balaam, “Please take me to another place. Then I will go there before the Lord, and He will give me my wish.”
verses.28: And Balak took Bilam, the head of the magician who could see into the future.
verses.29: And Bilam said to Balaam, “Give me seven golden altars. And give me also seven sheep and seven goats.”
verses.30: And Balak did as Balaam said. He sent sheep and goats into the valley.
